page0.text: With the enemy defeated, only one task remains.
page0.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-17:page0:1

page1.text:
The dark hollow in the sky.
The mud has stopped pouring from it, but that eerie void continues to quicken.
It's the Holy Grail.
The omnipotent Grail said to be given to the winner of this war.
page1.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-17:page1:1

page2.text:
The wind howls.
With Kotomine gone, the power binding Illya vanishes.
Illya's been released from the hollow, and now she sleeps beside me.
page2.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-17:page2:1

page3.text:
She doesn't seem to be in danger of dying.
She'll probably wake up after we go home and have Tohsaka look her over.
page3.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-17:page3:1

page4.text:
...The war has ended.
No one else will get hurt. We won't have to lose anyone else now.
No more Masters, and the Servants will disappear now that their roles are over.
page4.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-17:page4:1

page5.text:
I knew this was going to happen.
I climbed those long stairs with her earlier.
We've already said our goodbyes.
All that's left is to bring the curtain down on this whole war.
page5.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-17:page5:1

page6.text:
...
I look up at the hollow and wait, my heart as empty as that void.
And then she appears.
She walks straight towards me, looking no different than when we first met.
page6.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-17:page6:1

page7.text:
...
She stops once we're close enough to touch each other.
We neither ask about each other's well-being, nor offer any congratulations.
This has already been decided.
There's only one thing left to do.
page7.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-17:page7:1

page8.text:
"I will destroy the Holy Grail. That is my role."
Saber starts walking forward.
The strong winds coming from the hollow do not deter her. She approaches, one step at a time.
page8.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-17:page8:1

page9.text:
...
She's within range.
She quietly readies her sword and looks up at the black hollow.
page9.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-17:page9:1

page10.text:
I just watch from where I stand.
I clench my fists so hard they bleed, I bite my lip, and I try to hold back the feelings fighting for expression... I try to burn the image of her into my mind.
And then...
page10.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-17:page10:1

page11.text:
"Master, your orders, please. Without your order, I cannot destroy that thing."
Her back still to me, she tells me to use my final Command Spell.
page11.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-17:page11:1

page12.text:
When the Holy Grail is destroyed, Saber will disappear.
No...since Saber will destroy the Holy Grail with her own hands, she won't have to become a Servant.
page12.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-17:page12:1

page13.text:
She only became a Servant because she sought the Holy Grail.
Destroying the Holy Grail should also void her contract, since she will have chosen to do it.
The moment she destroys the Holy Grail...
...her life will end, but she will remain king forever.
page13.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-17:page13:1

page14.text:
"Shirou. I would like to hear it from your own lips."
I hear Saber.
Every time I hear her voice, I want to scream.
I want to tell her not to go.
I want to scream my real, honest desire: I want her to stay.
page14.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-17:page14:1

page15.text:
...
And yet...
I can't ever, ever say that.
page15.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-17:page15:1

page16.text:
I love Saber.
I want her to be happy more than anything else, and I want to be with her forever.
But if I really love her, that's not what I should be doing.
I love Saber...for fighting her hardest, even when she was wounded.
She gave up everything, and while she was torn apart, she still held to her conviction. Even to the very end.
page16.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-17:page16:1

page17.text:
If I think that is beautiful... If I think that is something worth protecting...
...then I can't destroy everything she stood for just for my own happiness.
page17.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-17:page17:1

page18.text:
She was born a king, and that's how she lived.
Nothing can change that. From the moment she drew the sword and made her vow, she was king. Nothing else.
That is her conviction.
She fought her battles until the very end, believing she was doing the right thing.
page18.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-17:page18:1

page19.text:
The dream of a young girl named Altria...
She abandoned her own life and chose to be king.
She chose to fight.
Even when she was told that everything she does would go unrewarded, she still wielded the sword and kept to her vow as king.
That lasted for many years...
I can't do anything to tarnish the pride she held to until her final moments.
page19.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-17:page19:1

page20.text:
"Saber. Fulfill your duty, please."
My voice is heavy with emotion.
page20.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-17:page20:1

page21.text:
Light flares around us.
The brilliant ray cuts the hollow in front of us in half, leaving no trace of it.
page21.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-17:page21:1

page22.text:
Nothing remains.
The mountain's summit has been blasted away, leaving only a smoldering wasteland behind.
In the distance, the first rays of dawn light the sky.
A glimmer of gold peeks over the horizon.
page22.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-17:page22:1

page23.text:
"..."
My left hand hurts.
The final Command Spell disappears.
And then...
I accept that it is finally over.
page23.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-17:page23:1

page24.text:
"So, it has come to an end."
"Yeah. This is the end. There's nothing left."
page24.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-17:page24:1

page25.text:
"I see. Then our contract has also ended. I was your sword, I defeated your enemies, and protected you.
I am glad I could keep that pledge."
page25.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-17:page25:1

page26.text:
"Yeah. You did well, Saber."
I don't know what else to say.
Saber is far away. I don't try to run to her.
page26.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-17:page26:1

page27.text:
The sun rises.
The wind starts to pick up.
A golden glimmer shines, seeming to last forever.
In it...
"There is one thing I must tell you."
I can hear the determination in her voice.
page27.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-17:page27:1

page28.text:
"Yeah, what is it?"
I try to at least sound strong.
Saber sways.
page28.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-17:page28:1

page29.text:
She turns.
Saber looks straight at me and says, her voice clear,
"I love you, Shirou."
She...said it.
page29.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-17:page29:1

page30.text:
The wind blows over the mountaintop.
For a moment, I close my eyes, blinded by the morning sun. Then I open them again.
page30.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-17:page30:1

page31.text:
...
I don't think I was surprised.
I just had a feeling.
Our goodbye...
...was always going to be like this.
page31.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-17:page31:1

page32.text:
All I see is the wasteland.
Saber is gone, carried off by the gusting wind.
Just like when she appeared.
She left with grace, without a trace.
page32.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-17:page32:1

page33.text:
"Yeah...that's so like you."
There are no regrets in my voice.
Every memory, both of what I've lost and of what I've gained, remains in my heart. I'll keep them all there. Forever.
page33.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-17:page33:1

page34.text: I look out at the rising sun, hoping I never forget any of this, that none of it fades from my mind for a long time to come.
page34.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-17:page34:1

page35.text:
I watch the morning glow spreading over the distant land below.
It reminds me of the golden fields she'd fought on.
page35.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-17:page35:1
